comment: agent-id -> where the skill goes. 'bundle' dirs ship with SKILL.md so the install is self-contained. Used by install.sh; the README install matrix mirrors this file. './install.sh' with no argument probes this machine (binary on PATH, ~/.<runtime> dir, or a project marker like ./.claude) and reports the target for each runtime it finds; './install.sh auto' then installs into all of them — project markers win over the global location, and cursor/windsurf/copilot are skipped when their project dir is absent since they have no global one.

hermes.comment: Hermes has NO project-level skills dir: it scans $HERMES_HOME/skills (default ~/.hermes/skills) plus skills.external_dirs only, so --global is a no-op. Skills must nest as <category>/<name>/, and the gateway caches the skill index in-process — restart it after installing.
